notes.title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket - Patch 1.2.0.10
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/2e9847406e8641d436ed2d593dc12136f4e0c16c.gif[/img]

[h1]🛒 Greetings, Shop Owners! 🛒[/h1]

While you've been busy managing your stores, we've been cleaning up behind the scenes! 🧹

[h2]Performance & Stability ⚡[/h2]
- Improved performance in large stores
- Smoother camera movement across all framerates 
- Enhanced customer pathfinding (customers will less frequently stand around when unable to find items)

[h2]Bug Fixes 🛠️[/h2]
- Playtime is now correctly displayed in save slots (including over 24 hours)
- Game properly pauses in the pause menu (time no longer continues)
- Quest progress is maintained when returning from main menu
- Green selection markers in the shop app now disappear without delay
- No more pedestrians wearing Christmas hats in the outdoor area
- Auto-Restocking could sometimes not be toggled (the UI would change but the behaviour would not).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/7447872e206d731cbe3c9d6366030735568d3a69.png[/img]

Thanks for playing our games! See you in the shop! ❤️

[i]Stable regards,
Three River Games (3RG)[/i]

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket - 1.1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1]🎄 Merry Shopping, Shop Owners! 🛒[/h1]

Version 1.1.0.1 has arrived with a whole shopping cart full of goodies! 🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/3143c3dd5a6f932107dc22498a05cdb80424c519.png[/img]

The most frequent feedback in recent weeks has been the desire for more content! Here's an overview of the changes we made! 😊

[h2]New Items in Stock! 🥬[/h2]

[b]Fruits & Veggies[/b] 🥗:
Garlic, Kiwis, Mangos, Mushrooms, Onions, Potatoes, and Tomatoes

[b]Shelf Items[/b] 📦:
Chewing Gum, All-Purpose Spice, BBQ Spice, Fish Spice, Instant Noodles, and Paper Tissues

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/89b8d2ae149a1ad55a462bc077b220982b3561a4.png[/img]

[h2]New Decoration Elements! 🎨[/h2]

Design your store more individually:
- 10 new wall panels in various colors and patterns
- 9 awesome floor panels
- 3 finishing elements for wall panels

The new items and decoration elements can be unlocked through licenses as usual. The unlocking of new items begins after unlocking the existing ones! 😎

[h2]Waifu Pillows in Stock 👗[/h2]

Psst! Our next project is around the corner! Get a sneak peek at "Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows" with two special pillows now available in your shop. Plus, the digital poster stand in your shop got a "waifu update"! 🌟 💝️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/43b1ec4e277c8c26e4d3b9d0a141d5c6431a015a.png[/img]

Starting with this version, you'll also find info about our other games in the start and pause menus. Check out the complete Shop Simulator franchise lineup! 🎮

[h2]Performance Update ⚡[/h2]

We've tweaked some settings to make large shops run smoother. Here's what's new:

- Optimized framerate when carrying Click & Collect boxes
- Optimized rendering: Only visible objects are rendered
- New customer limit for better performance in large shops
- Reduced decals on pillars, registers, and fridges for improved performance

With these optimizations, we measured up to 100 additional frames per second in large, well-stocked shops.

[h2]Christmas Special! 🎅[/h2]

'Tis the season! Your customers are now wearing festive Santa hats! Time for some holiday shopping... 🎄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/0e36e89235ed74658a9d84a2517ce1db2b08a4fd.gif[/img]

[h2]Employee Update 🏃[/h2]

We've worked on employee efficiency. Here's an overview:

- Later unlocked employees work faster
- Employees become up to 20% faster with shop level (e.g., a level 5 employee is 10% faster at shop level 15)
- Achievements for specific items (e.g., sell 200 Salami Pizzas) are now also unlocked through employee sales

[h2]Bugfixes 🛠️[/h2]

- Removed the mysterious floating light construction
- Shelves can now only be placed on the floor (no more floating shelf magic!)
- Quest markers at game start are improved and no longer point to full shelves when you need to stock items

[h2]New Language: Czech 🏰[/h2]

Czech language is now available! Big thanks to "kulový BLESK" for providing feedback! 🙏️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/7447872e206d731cbe3c9d6366030735568d3a69.png[/img]

As always, thank you for playing our game and sharing your feedback across all channels! ❤️

Have fun decorating and selling, and have a wonderful holiday season! 🎅🎄

[i]Festive regards,
Three River Games (3RG)[/i]

PS: The game will also be updated to version 1.1.0.1 on PS5 very soon! :)

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket - 1.0.5.2
notes.notes:
[h1]🛒 Greetings, Shop Owners! 🛒[/h1]

Version 1.0.5.2 has just gone live! 😎

Here's an overview of the changes in this patch:

[h3]Multiplayer 👨‍👦‍👦[/h3]
We have significantly reduced the amount of information that needs to be synchronized over the network for multiplayer. This ensures that multiplayer runs more stably and that larger shops no longer crash.

Additionally, we have fixed a bug in multiplayer that caused a cash register to become unusable.

[h3]Improved User Feedback When Stocking Shelves 🛒[/h3]
We've enhanced the visual and auditory experience when stocking goods! Every time you place an item on the shelf, there is now a subtle particle effect and a new sound effect.

[h3]Enhanced Soundscape 🎧[/h3]
As shop sizes grew and automatic shelf restocking increased, the noises became a bit overwhelming. Therefore, in the new version, you'll only hear the money sound when you actually earn money.

[h3]Norwegian 🐟[/h3]
We're pleased to announce that Shop Simulator is now available in Norwegian. Many thanks to [b]TrasMaTech[/b] for proofreading the translation and offering improvement suggestions.

[h3]Correct Time Display 🕰️[/h3]
A small detail we forgot to mention in the last patch notes: Since version 1.0.4.1, "12 PM" is now correctly displayed instead of "12 AM" starting from noon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/a1e74ecf4e2cf449cbc653cd9ac6669dac9b6d19.png[/img]
We wish you lots of fun playing!

[i]Best regards,
Three River Games (3RG)[/i]

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket - 1.0.4.1
notes.notes:
[h1]🛒 Greetings, Shop Owners! 🛒[/h1]

Version 1.0.4.1 is now live! 😎

Here’s a quick overview of the changes in this patch:

[h3]Flexible opening hours 🕖[/h3]

Many of you reached out to us with feedback that the days felt too short. So, starting with this patch, you’ll be able to set your shop's opening and closing times in the settings. If you want a longer day, you can now keep your customers happy from as early as 4:00 a.m. until 11:00 p.m.!

[h3]Pausing the game ⏸️[/h3]

When the menu or a tutorial opens in single-player, the game will now automatically pause.

[h3]Performance ⚙️[/h3]

We’ve implemented several optimizations that increase the framerate on our machines by 10 to 20 frames per second.

[h3]VSync setting 📺 [/h3]

VSync doesn’t work the same on all hardware and can cause performance issues even with good hardware. Now you have the option to toggle VSync on or off in the settings. If VSync is on, the FPS setting will be ignored and the monitor’s frame rate will be used instead.

[h3]Achievements 🏆[/h3]

We’ve made optimizations to the Steam achievement logic since we received reports that achievements were not unlocking in certain cases.

[h3]Cashier 👨🏻‍💼[/h3]

We’ve ensured that the cashier’s position is correctly set so that they no longer appear to be floating in the office in some cases.

[h3]Camera rotation speed 📸[/h3]

The speed at which the camera rotates while walking around is now independent of the frame rate.

[h3]UI fix for Steam Deck and UltraWide monitors 🖥️[/h3]

The summary dialog at the end of the day was not displaying correctly on Steam Deck and UltraWide monitors.

[h3]Localization 📜[/h3]

We’ve improved several translations in the European Portuguese variant. This includes the game menus as well as the names of some licenses and items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/408ee18e36bfcf18adba82f4467802f01a5bc32f.png[/img]
We wish you lots of fun playing and a spooky Halloween! 🦇🕷️🎃👻💀

[i]Best regards,
Three River Games (3RG)[/i]

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket - 1.0.3.1
notes.notes:
[h1]🛒 Greetings, Shop Owners! 🛒[/h1]

We’ve just released version 1.0.3.1 with some juicy improvements! 😋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/c261aa1ea9cb3d63e2ed0b143b66ff05b51021d2.png[/img]

[h2]What’s changed?[/h2]

[b]Achievements 🏆[/b]  
Many of you noticed that achievements weren’t working. This was of course a critical issue and we’ve fixed it right away. 💪

[b]Performance 🛠️[/b]  
We’ve worked on the performance and managed to increase the frame rate by around 30 FPS on our development PCs. 🥳

[b]New: Camera options for the cash register 📷[/b]  
You can now adjust the field of view and the camera speed for the cash register in the settings. The new options are located under the “cash register” tab. We’ve also updated the default FOV for the cash register from 40 to 60 degrees.

[b]Localization 📜[/b]  
Traditional and Simplified Chinese are now automatically detected at first launch based on your system language. Additionally, we corrected a typo in the English volume settings.

Thank you to everyone providing valuable feedback. We wish you all lots of fun playing! 🛒🖐

[i]Best regards,  
Three River Games (3RG)[/i]

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket - Release
notes.notes:
[h1]🛒 Greetings, Shop Owners! 🛒[/h1]

The time has come! After playtests and the demo, we are thrilled to finally release the full version of [b]Shop Simulator: Supermarket[/b]! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/e178bac28a6b0ea988d07ffd70bd933fbe25691f.png[/img]

[h2]A huge thank you to all shop owners! 💛[/h2]

First of all, we want to give a big thanks to everyone who participated in the playtests and played the demo. Thank you for your support! 🙏

[h2]What can you expect? 🛒[/h2]

In [b]Shop Simulator: Supermarket[/b], you’ll open and run your very own shop! Stock your shelves with fresh products, take care of your customers, and decorate your supermarket.

We wish you tons of fun and can’t wait to celebrate your first successes as a shop owner with you! 

[h2]Got cool screenshots or feedback? 📸✨[/h2]

Feel free to stop by our official 3RG Discord if you want to connect directly with us or other players:

[url=https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3]https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3[/url]

[h2]Found any bugs? 🐛[/h2]

On our website, you’ll find instructions with all the information we need to fix any bugs you encounter. Here’s the link:

[url=https://3rg.eu/bug-reports/]https://3rg.eu/bug-reports/[/url]

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket - 1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]🛒 Greetings, Shop Owners! 🛒[/h1]

It is great to see how many of you already started their shop owner journey. We just released a new patch with features and fixes for you in version 1.0.2.0 😋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/e178bac28a6b0ea988d07ffd70bd933fbe25691f.png[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[b]User interface 🕹️[/b]
To give you feedback that the game is still loading we added an animated icon while the scenario is being prepared.

[b]Controls 🏃‍♂️[/b]
You can now use arrow keys for movement. Running is also possible with the right shift key.

[b]Sliding issue ❄️[/b]
We got reports about the movement feeling like being on ice, so we made the player movement more crisp.

[b]Wall placement 🖼️[/b]
We now automatically rotate brand panels and advertisements TVs towards you when you place them on a wall.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]Shelf on boxes 📦[/b]
Some of you experienced crashes when placing a shelf in a pile of boxes. This is now fixed.

[b]Localization 🌐[/b]
Minor localization adjustments, e.g. for the settings.

[h2]Contribute to Localization[/h2]

With [b]Localizor[/b] you can make suggestions and vote on suggestions made by others. Thank you for your support!

[url=https://www.localizor.com/shop-simulator]https://www.localizor.com/shop-simulator[/url]

[i]All the best,
